title: Add grading_table JSONField to ProblemFillBlankConfig and ProblemShortAnswerConfig models
acceptance_criteria: ProblemFillBlankConfig gains a grading_table = models.JSONField(null=True, blank=True, default=None) with help_text describing the sub-question structure
ProblemShortAnswerConfig gains a grading_table = models.JSONField(null=True, blank=True, default=None) with help_text describing the sub-question structure
grading_table stores a list of dicts, each with keys: 'label' (str), 'score' (float), 'strictness' (str: 'Strict'|'Normal'|'Lenient'), and optionally 'reference' (str)
grading_table=None means old single-case grading behavior (backward compatible)
